name: Vespro + Vespro Weather - CS (Oct 2026)
notes: Vespro (https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/194250, 8 Oct 2026) + CS tonemap patch (10 Oct 2026). Own CS tonemap -> Bearforj tonemap mix 30%. Cloudy/foggy nights are meant to be very dark: low night lift. Needs Helios (vanilla option) + Moons and Stars. Built for ENB; with Effects 11 the CS patch is not needed.
